traditional: Love, money, and pleasure combined with growth and fortune. Two benefics: easy, with a tendency to excess.

modern.blend: Pleasure meets expansion. Gentleness, generosity, sensitivity, and a great deal of ease.
modern.harmonious: Warmth, goodwill, and good fortune in what you value.
modern.business: Likable and fortunate; the missing ingredient is discipline.
